profile.visual_desc: Large muscular build with pale skin and wild white hair. Wears layered grey and tan robes, a blue waist sash, and a thick white fur mane.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Pale face featuring sharp black markings around piercing blue eyes, framed by shaggy white hair with a stoic, focused expression.
profile.weapon_desc: A long-handled curved polearm held with both hands during the swing.
profile.step1_ready: Crouched isometric stance facing DOWN-RIGHT; holds the polearm vertically in the right hand.
profile.step2_windup: Lowers the body and shifts the weapon horizontally to the side, preparing a wide circular sweep.
profile.step3_impact: Rotates the body fully, projecting a massive golden crescent energy wave that arcs toward the bottom-right.
profile.step4_finish: Completes the spinning rotation while the golden trail fades, settling back into a grounded recovery pose.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 follows a circular 360-degree trajectory matching the centrifugal sweep of the polearm.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation follows reference poses accurately. Biomechanics and VFX alignment remain consistent throughout the sequence.
